ITEM 1 | Smooth, oval, tan-to-medium-brown nut-like pieces with a slightly pointed tip and a matte, dry-looking skin, some with faint darker creases. Roughly 2.5 cm long and 1.5 cm wide, about 55 pieces piled in a loose mound in the center and right of the plate, with a few scattered at the lower left. Firm and whole, not crumbly or oily, with no visible sauce or glaze. | 68
ITEM 2 | A tiny pale-green speck, about 0.5 cm, lying on the plate at the lower left edge of the pile. Dry-looking and flat. | 0.3
